status: DRAFT 2026-10-21 (strategic window, at the operator's request; awaiting operator approval). Thresholds are a-priori drafts, to be calibrated when the mass tier is built; never fitted to outcomes.
structure: Same as NBA v4: role archetypes (players are weighted hybrids across them) + cross-cutting modifiers. Each archetype carries group, name, notes, signals, threshold; each modifier name, notes, threshold. GG-### in a threshold = the signal has no free source yet.
groups: QB, RB, WR, TE, OL, EDGE/DL, LB, CB, S (the operator's deep-tier scope: QB, WR, RB, TE, OL, core defenders)

QB-1.name: Pocket Distributor
QB-1.notes: Wins on timing and processing from the pocket
QB-1.signals: time to throw, out-of-pocket rate, short-mid aDOT, CPOE

QB-2.name: Mobile Creator
QB-2.notes: Extends plays and runs by design or scramble
QB-2.signals: scramble rate, designed QB runs, rush EPA, out-of-pocket rate
QB-2.threshold: Scramble >= 6% of dropbacks or >= 4 designed runs/g; rush EPA/play > 0

QB-3.name: Downfield Gunslinger
QB-3.notes: Pushes the ball vertically, accepts risk
QB-3.signals: aDOT, deep-attempt rate (20+ air yds), interception-worthy rate, big-time throws

QB-4.name: System / Play-Action Manager
QB-4.notes: Production tied to scheme (PA, screens, RPO)
QB-4.signals: play-action share, screen/RPO share, EPA gap PA vs non-PA
QB-4.threshold: PA share >= 28% or screen+RPO share >= 20%; EPA gap PA - non-PA >= 0.15

QB-5.name: Pressure Resister
QB-5.notes: Holds efficiency when pressured or blitzed
QB-5.signals: EPA and sack rate under pressure, vs blitz, pressure-to-sack rate
QB-5.threshold: EPA/dropback under pressure in top third; pressure-to-sack <= 15%

QB-6.name: Checkdown Conservator
QB-6.notes: Avoids negative plays, low aDOT, low turnovers
QB-6.signals: aDOT, sack rate, INT rate, throwaway rate

RB-1.name: Workhorse
RB-1.notes: Carries the backfield load in all phases
RB-1.signals: carry share, snap share, goal-line share, routes on pass downs

RB-2.name: Explosive Runner
RB-2.signals: 10+ yd rush rate, breakaway %, yards after contact, broken tackles

RB-3.name: Receiving Back
RB-3.notes: Primary pass-game role from the backfield
RB-3.signals: target share, routes run, receiving yds per route, pass-down snap share

RB-4.name: Grinder / Short-Yardage
RB-4.notes: Converts short yardage, low explosive rate

RB-5.name: Change-of-Pace / Committee
RB-5.signals: snap share, split carries with a primary back

WR-YAC.name: YAC / Short-Game Weapon
WR-YAC.signals: YAC per reception, short-target rate, screen share

WR-SLOT.name: Slot Specialist
WR-SLOT.notes: Works inside; option and choice routes
WR-SLOT.threshold: Slot alignment >= 60% of routes (GG-775: alignment not yet free)

WR-CC.name: Contested / Red-Zone Winner
WR-CC.notes: Wins at the catch point, red-zone target
WR-CC.signals: contested-ball rate and win rate, red-zone target share
WR-CC.threshold: Contested targets >= 15% of targets; red-zone target share >= 20%

TE-1.name: Inline Blocker
TE-1.notes: Attached to the line, run-game first
TE-1.signals: inline snap share, run-block snaps, target share

TE-2.name: Move / Flex Receiver
TE-2.notes: Detached receiver in a TE body
TE-2.signals: slot/wide snap share, target share, aDOT
TE-2.threshold: Target share >= 16% or slot+wide >= 50% of snaps

TE-3.name: Hybrid Two-Way TE
TE-3.notes: Blocks and catches at a starter's rate
TE-3.signals: snap share, routes run share, run-block snaps

TE-4.name: Red-Zone Specialist
TE-4.threshold: Red-zone target share >= 15% at low overall share

OL-1.name: Pass-Pro Anchor
OL-1.notes: Wins pass sets, rarely allows pressure
OL-1.signals: pressures allowed per pass-block snap, pass-block win rate
OL-1.threshold: Pass-block win rate top third; pressures allowed <= 3% of pass snaps (GG-776)

OL-2.name: Run-Game Mauler
OL-2.signals: run-block win rate, yards before contact on runs to his gap

OL-3.name: Zone-Scheme Mover
OL-3.notes: Reach and climb blocks; outside-zone fit
OL-3.signals: outside-zone share of team runs, run-block win rate on zone
OL-3.threshold: Team outside-zone share >= 40% with positive zone RBWR

OL-4.name: Liability / Target
OL-4.signals: pressures and penalties allowed, blown-block rate
OL-4.threshold: Bottom quartile on pressures allowed or >= 6 penalties per 600 snaps

DL-1.name: Speed Edge Rusher
DL-1.signals: pass-rush win rate, pressure rate, time to pressure
DL-1.threshold: Pass-rush win rate top third; pressure rate >= 12% (GG-778)

DL-2.name: Power Edge / Run-Setter
DL-2.notes: Sets the edge, collapses the pocket
DL-2.signals: run-stop win rate, pressures, TFL rate

DL-3.name: Interior Penetrator
DL-3.signals: interior pass-rush win rate, TFL, pressure rate

DL-4.name: Nose / Two-Gap Anchor
DL-4.signals: double-team rate, run-stop rate, snap share on early downs
DL-4.threshold: Double-team rate high; pass-rush snaps <= 50% of snaps

DL-5.name: Rotational Pass-Rush Specialist
DL-5.threshold: Snap share 25-50%, concentrated on passing downs

LB-1.name: Coverage LB
LB-1.notes: Carries backs and TEs, plays zone depth
LB-1.signals: targets allowed, yards per coverage snap, coverage snap share
LB-1.threshold: Coverage snap share >= 55% with yards allowed per cov snap below median

LB-2.name: Downhill Run Stopper
LB-2.notes: Fills and finishes against the run
LB-2.signals: run-stop rate, tackles for loss, missed-tackle rate
LB-2.threshold: Run stops top third; missed tackles <= 10%

LB-4.name: Green-Dot Signal Caller
LB-4.threshold: Snap share >= 95%, wears the green dot

CB-1.name: Man-Coverage Shadow
CB-1.signals: shadow rate, targets per cov snap in man, yards per cov snap
CB-1.threshold: Travels with WR1 >= 50% of snaps in man (GG-777)

CB-2.name: Zone / Off-Coverage Corner
CB-2.signals: zone snap share, yards per cov snap in zone, INT/PBU rate
CB-2.threshold: Team zone rate high and CB yards per cov snap below median

CB-3.name: Slot / Nickel Defender
CB-3.notes: Inside, run fits and short zones
CB-3.signals: slot snap share, run-stop rate, targets in slot

CB-4.name: Press-Physical Corner
CB-4.signals: press rate, penalties, contested catches allowed

CB-5.name: Target / Weak Link
CB-5.signals: targets per cov snap, yards per cov snap, completion % allowed
CB-5.threshold: Top quartile on targets per cov snap and yards allowed

S-1.name: Deep Single-High Eraser
S-1.signals: deep alignment rate, explosive plays allowed, range

S-2.name: Box / Robber Safety
S-2.notes: Plays near the line, run and underneath
S-2.signals: box alignment rate, run stops, tackles

S-3.name: Hybrid Coverage Safety
S-3.signals: slot/man coverage snaps, yards per cov snap

M-1.name: Elite Processing Speed
M-1.notes: QB/receiver reads; throws before receivers break

M-2.name: Elite Arm / Deep Accuracy
M-2.threshold: Deep completion % top quartile on >= 3 deep att/g

M-6.name: Elite Contested Catcher
M-6.threshold: Contested catch rate >= 55% on >= 15 contested targets

M-7.name: Elite Route Tree / Versatility
M-7.notes: Wins across the full tree and alignments
M-7.threshold: Positive yards per route on >= 6 route types

M-10.name: Elite Pass Protector (non-OL)
M-10.notes: Back or TE who stonewalls blitzers
M-10.threshold: Pressures allowed per pass-block snap bottom decile

M-11.name: Elite Run-Game Gravity
M-11.notes: Defenses load the box for him
M-11.threshold: 8+ box faced rate top decile (FTN box counts)

M-13.name: Elite Run-Stop Win Rate
M-13.notes: Wins at the point vs the run

M-14.name: Elite Ball Skills (DB)
M-14.threshold: INT + PBU per target top decile

M-15.name: Elite Tackler
M-15.threshold: Missed-tackle rate bottom decile on >= 40 attempts

M-16.name: Penalty Liability
M-16.threshold: Accepted penalties per 600 snaps top decile

M-17.name: Scheme-Dependent Production
M-17.threshold: Production drops >= 30% outside his primary alignment or concept

M-18.name: Volume Fragility
M-18.notes: Efficient on small usage, untested at volume

M-19.name: Injury-Managed / Snap-Limited
M-19.notes: Documented snap limit or managed workload

M-20.name: Developmental Upside
M-20.threshold: Week-over-week efficiency trend top decile, years <= 2

M-21.name: Veteran Decline / IQ Compensation
M-21.notes: Age-related athletic decline offset by technique
M-21.threshold: Age 31+ with falling speed metrics and stable production

M-24.name: Specialist: Two-Minute / Hurry-Up
M-24.notes: Role grows in no-huddle and end-of-half

M-26.name: Specialist: Gadget / Motion Weapon
M-26.threshold: Motion-at-snap usage top decile with designed touches

M-27.name: Specialist: Blitz Magnet (QB)
M-27.notes: Defenses blitz him far above league rate

M-30.name: High Variance / Boom-Bust
M-30.threshold: sd of weekly yards top quartile for role

M-31.name: Low Variance / Floor
M-31.threshold: sd of weekly yards bottom quartile for role

M-32.name: Weather / Surface Sensitive
M-32.notes: Splits by dome vs outdoor, wind, cold
M-32.threshold: Efficiency split >= 25% between conditions on adequate sample
